scoring: In the Power BI model, DAX calculated columns on dim_customer score recency, frequency, and monetary value from 1 to 4; the R-F-M code (for example 444) links to the segment table.

report.source: Values as shown on the Customer Analysis page of the Power BI report (customer counts rounded to the nearest 100, as the report displays them).

segments.description: Bought recently and often, and spends a lot.
segments.action: Retain: VIP perks, loyalty appreciation programs, or special experiences.
Encourage repeat purchases with reminder emails, exclusive promotions, or a loyalty program.

segments.description: Bought recently and spends a lot, but not often.
segments.action: Raise purchase frequency with next-purchase discounts or reward points.

segments.description: Bought recently, with average frequency and spend.
segments.action: Grow basket size with related-product suggestions or bundle deals.

segments.description: Not very recent, but high value.
segments.action: Maintain the relationship: personalized gifts and special offers on occasions like birthdays.

segments.description: Recent but low frequency and spend, or frequent and high value but not recent.
segments.action: Stay in touch: periodic emails with small offers to keep interest.

segments.description: Hasn't bought in a while; average spend.
segments.action: Reactivate with a big offer or reminders about products they bought before.

segments.description: Used to be high value but hasn't bought recently.
segments.action: Run appreciation campaigns and send reminders with special offers to win them back.

segments.description: Hasn't bought in a very long time.
segments.action: Find out why they left: customer surveys and special offers to bring them back.
